python_script_action.execution_code:
async def code_fn(page):
    from patchright.async_api import expect
    await expect(page).to_have_url('https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/its-only-the-himalayas_981/index.html', timeout=5000)
    await expect(page.locator('.product_main h1')).to_have_text("It's Only the Himalayas", timeout=5000)
    await expect(page.get_by_text('Product Information', exact=True)).to_be_visible(timeout=5000)
